get.description:
Pairs of a buyer and a supplier with repeated accepted direct purchases just under the
legal limit of their contract type, most purchases first.

A purchase is near the limit from `rule.share` of it to just under it. A purchase whose type is
not known cannot be checked: `checked` of `accepted_total` were, and `first_day` and
`last_day` bound those. As csv: every pair, one line per purchase.

get.description: One award notice, by SEAP's own id, in the version in force when it was collected.
Every contract of one notice, whatever its date, in SEAP's order of signing.

Contracts signed in the period we hold, newest or largest first.

Framework agreements are left out: their value is a ceiling, and what is committed
under them are their subsequent contracts, which are listed. The list is not complete:
SEAP publishes many contracts weeks after they are signed.

get.description: What an institution awarded in the period we hold. Each contract is counted once.

What a company won in the period we hold, alone and in associations.

SEAP gives one value for a contract won by an association and does not split it between
the members, so `association` carries the whole value of those contracts. The two
figures must never be added.

Companies by the value of the contracts they won, alone or in associations.

A contract won by an association appears at every member with its whole value.

post.description:
Tell us that something on a page is wrong. A person reads it before anything changes.

A reader may send a few reports an hour. The site passes the reader's address on in
`X-Forwarded-For`; a call made straight to the API counts under the caller's own.

get.description: What was corrected after a reader's report: the page and what changed, newest first.

published_at.title: Published At
published_at.description: Of the version we hold, the latest.

first_published_at.title: First Published At
first_published_at.description: The earliest publication SEAP lists. Null until the versions are collected.

versions.title: Versions
versions.description: Null until the versions are collected.

detail.description: Null until the detail is collected.

total.title: Total
total.description: Ordinary and subsequent contracts of this notice, whatever their date.

counted.title: Counted
counted.description: False for a framework agreement: its value is a ceiling, not money committed, and is never added to a total.

winners.title: Winners
winners.description: In SEAP's order. More than one is an association: one value for all of them, never split, and SEAP does not say who leads.

Contract.title: Contract
Contract.description: One contract of an award notice. `value` is in lei without VAT.

period.description: Null for the contracts of one notice.

won.title: Won
won.description: alone or association, for a ranking of winners.

page.title: Page
page.description: The address of the page on the site; null when the report named no such page.

Correction.title: Correction
Correction.description: A report we checked and acted on: where, and what we changed, in our words.

code.title: Code
code.description: The first two digits of a CPV code, e.g. 45.

name.title: Name
name.description: SEAP's name for the division, where a row gives it.

complete.title: Complete
complete.description: False when the source publishes late, so the period keeps filling in.

days_collected.title: Days Collected
days_collected.description: Days of the period read in full from the source.

days_partial.title: Days Partial
days_partial.description: Days of the period the source would not give in full; they wait to be read.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Raw answers kept from the source, each under its hash.

rejected_rows.title: Rejected Rows
rejected_rows.description: Rows of those answers the parser could not read, logged and left out. Null until every answer was seen by a parser that counts them.

counts.title: Counts
counts.description: What is held, by kind of row. `records` is the one the totals use.

Dataset.title: Dataset
Dataset.description: One source as we hold it, for the table that says what the site is built on.

partners.title: Partners
partners.description: The suppliers of an institution, or the institutions a supplier sold to, by value of accepted purchases.

funder.description: The institution that funds it (its main credit holder), when held.

InstitutionBudget.title: InstitutionBudget
InstitutionBudget.description:
`place` is the UAT or county the institution governs, when it is a town hall or
a county council; every other institution has none, and no budget held.

executed_on.title: Executed On
executed_on.description: The day the figures run to: 31 December.

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.description: Total revenue; the lines add up to it exactly.

revenue_lines.title: Revenue Lines
revenue_lines.description: In the order the site shows them.

chapters.title: Chapters
chapters.description: Spending by what it was for, largest first; they add up to `spending`.

LocalBudgetOut.title: LocalBudgetOut

limit.title: Limit

limits.title: Limits
